iwad: Author-installed Doom II (development only); engine also loaded id24res.wad and bundled support/widescreen resources
map: MAP03 direct-map safe test profile; no map progression acceptance
rendering: Vulkan / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti; fresh isolated configs, no user autoload, sound disabled
measurement: Object.MSTimeF between WorldTick callbacks; cold_max is ticks 1-100, transitions_max 101-580 per tier. Includes scheduling/render work, not pure equip function duration. World simulation at native 35 Hz. Rendering comparisons use 512x1024 old/new textures side by side on black; original at x=0, optimized at x=512.
fixture: Local-only EventHandler acquires weapons through TryPickup, uses equipped native selectors, invokes existing primary/aim/reload callbacks, grants one arrow through GiveInventory and waits for actual timed reload. Loaded-control initial state is seeded to magazine=1 and inventory=1. Tier cases reset aim. No save-schema changes or save migration.
limitations: At the native-test boundary, physical keyboard/controller bindings and the normal inventory route required separate author acceptance under CA-4362-BOW-EMPTY-01; that acceptance is now recorded below. Native tests do not claim coverage of every renderer/device or accepted maps/furniture. Original exact user bow/tier remains unknown.
review: Separate inherited Codex/GPT-6 reviewer reconstructed all six baseline crop outputs including alpha and byte-identical PNG encoding, and reviewed final documentation; no actionable findings. Not a claimed DeepSeek review.

author_acceptance.source: Explicit author confirmation in the Codex acceptance follow-up
author_acceptance.qualifications: No exceptions or additional timing, renderer or per-tier measurements supplied. The separate issue #9 flail check remains pending.
